user.title: Add room
user.description: One entry per room: pick the real TRV climate entities, optionally an external temperature sensor, and set the guards that throttle offset writes.

data_description.name: Shown in the UI and used as the entry name. Must be unique; cannot be changed later.
data_description.trvs: The real radiator thermostats of this room. All listed TRVs follow one shared target; 1-2 devices is the intended range.
data_description.temp_sensor: Optional: an absolute temperature measurement for the room. Set it to calibrate against the real room temperature; leave empty to use the mean of the TRV internal sensors plus the trim.
data_description.deadband: Smallest correction that triggers an offset write, in K. Smaller mismatches are ignored so the TRVs do not flap.
data_description.write_rate_limit_minutes: At most one offset write per TRV in this many minutes.
data_description.staleness_minutes: A measurement older than this many minutes counts as stale and causes no calibration writes. Setpoint and offset registers are exempt.
data_description.update_interval_seconds: How often the coordinator reads the TRVs and sensors and refreshes the virtual climate.

error.invalid_config: These values do not form a valid room configuration. Check the selected entities.

init.title: Configure {name}
init.description: Entities, calibration and guard values of this room. The room name is not editable here.
